  {α ι : Type} [MetricSpace α]
  (f : ι → α → ℝ) (h : ∀ i, Continuous (f i))
  (g : α → ℝ) (hg : Continuous g) :
  IsClosed {x : α | (∀ i, f i x = 0) ∧ 0 ≤ g x} := by
  have h1 : ∀ (i : ι), IsClosed {x : α | f i x = 0} := by
    intro i
    have h₂ : IsClosed ({0} : Set ℝ) := isClosed_singleton
    have h₃ : Continuous (f i) := h i
    have h₄ : IsClosed ({x : α | f i x = 0} : Set α) := by
      
      have h₅ : {x : α | f i x = 0} = (f i) ⁻¹' ({0} : Set ℝ) := by
        ext x
        simp
      rw [h₅]
      exact h₂.preimage h₃
    exact h₄
  
  have h2 : IsClosed {x : α | ∀ i, f i x = 0} := by
    have h₂ : {x : α | ∀ i, f i x = 0} = ⋂ (i : ι), {x : α | f i x = 0} := by
      ext x
      simp [Set.mem_iInter]
      <;>
      aesop
    rw [h₂]
    
    apply isClosed_iInter
    intro i
    exact h1 i
  
  have h3 : IsClosed {x : α | 0 ≤ g x} := by
    have h₃ : IsClosed ({y : ℝ | 0 ≤ y} : Set ℝ) := isClosed_Ici
    have h₄ : Continuous g := hg
    have h₅ : IsClosed ({x : α | 0 ≤ g x} : Set α) := by
      
      have h₆ : {x : α | 0 ≤ g x} = g ⁻¹' ({y : ℝ | 0 ≤ y} : Set ℝ) := by
        ext x
        simp
      rw [h₆]
      exact h₃.preimage h₄
    exact h₅
  
  have h4 : IsClosed ({x : α | ∀ i, f i x = 0} ∩ {x : α | 0 ≤ g x}) := by
    apply IsClosed.inter h2 h3
  
  have h5 : IsClosed {x : α | (∀ i, f i x = 0) ∧ 0 ≤ g x} := by
    have h₅ : {x : α | (∀ i, f i x = 0) ∧ 0 ≤ g x} = {x : α | ∀ i, f i x = 0} ∩ {x : α | 0 ≤ g x} := by
      ext x
      simp [and_assoc]
      <;>
      aesop
    rw [h₅]
    exact h4
  
  exact h5
